Is There A Cancellation Fee To Close My Online Directory?
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682637
No, cancel anytime free of charge.
We ask that a timely notice is given to us before cancelling your account so we may work with you to properly close the directory.
